title: The Hilbert-Samuel function for one ideal of definition is bounded by that for another after rescaling
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file algebra.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: For two ideals of definition I and I' of a Noetherian local ring R and a finite module M, the lemma produces a constant a with the Hilbert-Samuel function for I at n bounded by that for I' at a n (statement lines 14351-14357). The proof does not compare the two functions term by term through their polynomial behaviour or the dimension theory behind them: it uses that ideals of definition contain powers of one another to find c with (I')^c contained in I, converts this into a surjection M/(I')^{c(n+1)}M onto M/I^{n+1}M, and then takes a = 2c - 1 (proof lines 14359-14363). Choosing the constant and turning the containment into the surjection is the whole content, and the author records exactly those steps. H2.
